newsitem.title: USA: US mortgage-backeds flat, narrower to Treasuries.
newsitem.headline: US mortgage-backeds flat, narrower to Treasuries.

text.p: Retail buying narrowed yield spreads of U.S. mortgage-backed securities over comparable Treasuries, traders said on Wednesday.
"Mortgages in general performed very well," one trader said. "Discount (coupons) are doing a little better on a duration-weighted basis," he added.
Most coupons saw buyers, but volume generally was modest, the traders said.
"I've seen some buying today in bits and pieces, but its been pretty quiet," one said.
Pass-throughs generally were unchanged late on Wednesday, slipping from earlier gains.
Ginnie Mae 30-year 8.0 percent coupons were unchanged at 100-10/32, yielding 118 basis points over 10-year Treasuries.
Comparable Fannie Mae certificates held even at 100-10/32, and Freddie Macs were unchanged at 100-14/32.

Treasuries trimmed their gains late in the day, as well, with both the 10- and five-year notes moving back toward unchanged. A report the U.S. international trade gap widened in August had given the market an early boost, according to fixed-income analysts.
